rows.text: H1 FY27 total income up 27.7% YoY to Rs 102.74 cr, PAT up 18.6% to Rs 4.85 cr; board also approves a proposed investment in Play Panda, pending due diligence (value not disclosed).
H1 FY27 revenue rises **27.70% YoY to Rs 102.74 crore** (management estimates); the board has approved buying 50% of Play Panda, subject to due diligence.
